batch.title: Multi-item order (one shipment)
batch.intro: Add one line per product, each with its own eShop. Supplier country and cargo partner below apply to the whole shipment. Weight isn't known yet — you'll enter it per item when the shipment is actually weighed at cargo payment time.
batch.weightNotArrivedHint: Nothing arrived on this line, so it has no weight to record and takes no share of the cargo cost.
batch.errWeightTotalMismatch: Total weight must equal the sum of the item weights ({{sum}} kg).
batch.weightTotalHint: Type into the total to spread the weight across the items, or enter each item and the total follows.
batch.errWeightRequiredForCargo: Weight is required for every item before paying cargo.
batch.payCargoGroupIntro: Enter the total cargo cost for this shipment once — it will be split across every item by weight.
batch.cargoAlreadyPaidHint: Cargo for this item was already paid separately. Its weight is kept for the split and cannot be changed here.
batch.cargoAlreadyPaidNote: Some items in this shipment already had their cargo paid separately. The totals below cover the whole shipment — what you enter here plus what was already paid — because the freight is re-divided by weight across every item.
batch.cargoSplitHint: The two share columns show live how the total above is divided by weight. The totals row always adds up to exactly the amount you entered.
batch.cargoWeightIntro: Enter each item's TOTAL weight (kg) below — for the whole quantity shown, not per unit (e.g. 10 t-shirts weighing 20kg altogether → enter 20, not 2). This determines how the cargo cost above is split per item ($/kg).
batch.payOrderGroupIntro: Each item has its own supplier cost — enter and confirm the amount for every line below.
batch.receiveIntro: Enter how many units actually arrived. If fewer arrived than ordered, the missing ones stay tracked until they turn up, the supplier refunds you, or you write them off.
batch.unpaidShortHint: This order is not marked paid yet, so a refund cannot be recorded against it. Run "Pay for the Order" first — then come back and record what the supplier sent back. Leaving it as is simply lowers what you owe.
batch.refundedHint: Tick this only if the supplier already gave the money back for the missing items.
batch.errReceivedQty: Received quantity must be between 0 and the ordered quantity.
batch.errRefundAmount: Enter the refunded amount in UZS or USD.
batch.shortfallWrittenOff: Undelivered item(s) written off as a loss

form.costHintOnDemand: Leave blank if supplier cost is not confirmed yet; you can record it when paying the order.
form.costHintStock: Optional until you have the supplier invoice; leave blank and pay later from the list.
form.clientNotesPlaceholder: Who / reference / sourcing (required when eShop is Client)
form.alreadyPaidTitleClient: Enter a USD cost per unit to mark paid at creation, or leave blank and pay later.
form.alreadyPaidTitleNeedCost: Enter a USD cost per unit above, or leave this unchecked and use Pay for the Order after you know the price.

paymentForm.receivedAndPayTitle: Mark Order as Received and Pay
paymentForm.intro: Enter the UZS and/or USD amount. Leave a field empty or 0 if not used.

cargoForm.title: Pay for Cargo - Order #{{id}}
cargoForm.intro: Enter the UZS and/or USD amount. If cargo was free, enter 0 in both fields and submit.

markOrderedForm.title: Mark as Ordered - Order #{{id}}
markOrderedForm.intro: Confirm the supplier order was placed. Cargo cost is optional; a note is required.
markOrderedForm.notesPlaceholder: What was ordered / supplier confirmation / reference

moveForm.title: Move to Inventory - Order #{{id}}
moveForm.returnAdvance: Return advance payment to customer — recorded advance:
moveForm.advanceHint: ≤ advance above · deducted from chosen cash · no FX
moveForm.advanceHintMixed: A mixed advance is returned in full, in both currencies.

table.cargoUnitVariesHint: Varies per product — expand the group to see each line's own cargo cost
table.avgSellingHint: Weighted average planned USD-only line totals per unit ordered (UZS-only lines excluded; no FX)

notifications.selectProductQty: Please select a product and enter a valid quantity.
notifications.selectEshop: Please select or enter an eShop.
notifications.selectCountry: Please select or enter a Supplier Country.
notifications.clientNotesRequired: Enter notes — required when eShop is Client.
notifications.selectCustomerOnDemand: Select a customer for on-demand orders.
notifications.sellingPriceRequired: Enter a selling price per unit in USD.
notifications.paidNeedCost: To mark the order as already paid, enter a USD cost per unit, or leave unpaid and record cost later.
notifications.paidUsdOnly: Recording “already paid” from this form is USD-only. Leave the order unpaid and split UZS/USD in “Pay for the Order”.
notifications.advanceExceedsSelling: Advance cannot exceed planned USD selling total ({{total}}).
notifications.noStatusPermission: You do not have permission to update order status.
notifications.notesRequired: Please enter notes for this order update.
notifications.paymentAmountRequired: Please enter at least one payment amount.
notifications.cargoWeightRequired: Enter the shipment's weight (kg) before paying cargo.
notifications.payOrderBeforeSell: Pay for the supplier order first (Pay for the Order) before selling this on‑demand product.
notifications.payCargoBeforeSell: Pay for the cargo first (use zero totals in that form if there is no freight). You cannot sell this on‑demand item until cargo is marked paid.
notifications.saleCreated: Sale created! Open the Sales tab to complete payment.
notifications.payBeforeInventory: Order payment must be completed before moving to inventory.
notifications.cargoBeforeInventory: Cargo must be marked paid before moving to inventory (use Pay for the Cargo; zero totals if there is no freight).
notifications.advanceReturnRequired: Enter how much advance to return (greater than zero).
notifications.advanceReturnExceeds: Return amount cannot exceed the recorded advance ({{booked}}).
notifications.noCancelPermission: You do not have permission to cancel orders.
notifications.orderTerminalReadonly: This order is finished (including cancelled). It is view-only — no further actions are allowed.

confirm.cargoZeroWithPlanned:
This order shows cargo amounts on record:
UZS: {{uzs}}; USD: {{usd}}

You submitted 0 everywhere — cargo will be recorded as FREE and those cargo amounts cleared.

Proceed?
confirm.cargoZeroNoPlanned: Record cargo as paid with no freight charge (all amounts zero)?
confirm.sellProduct:
Sell the product from order #{{id}}?
A pending sale will be created — complete it in Sales.
confirm.cancelOrder:
Cancel Order #{{id}}?

The order record will be kept. Paid supplier/cargo amounts will be reversed when applicable. This cannot undo completed inventory or sold states.
confirm.sellProductGroup:
Create a sale for every ready item in this order?

One pending sale per item, grouped together — complete the payment in the Sales tab. Items that arrived short are sold only for the quantity that actually came.
confirm.moveGroupToInventory:
Move every ready item in this order into inventory?

Items already sold are left alone.
confirm.cancelGroup:
Cancel every remaining item in this multi-item order?

Items already in inventory or sold are left untouched. Paid supplier/cargo amounts are reversed where applicable, and any cargo already paid is re-spread over the items that remain.
confirm.receiveRemaining:
Confirm that {{count}} outstanding item(s) for Order #{{id}} have now arrived?

They will be added to inventory.
confirm.markRefunded:
Mark the undelivered item(s) on Order #{{id}} as refunded by the supplier?

{{amount}} will be added back to your balance.
confirm.writeOff:
Write off the undelivered item(s) on Order #{{id}} as a loss?

No money moves — it already left when you paid. The cost is recorded as a loss in Profit & Loss and cannot be undone.
confirm.dropFromBill:
Stop billing for the undelivered items on Order #{{id}}?

This order is not marked paid, so no money moves — the supplier cost drops to what actually arrived. If you already paid and the supplier refunded you, record the payment first instead.
